description: This file defines the interface for internal server-side media pipeline operations in the Rialto project, including factory creation and data handling methods for media playback.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineServerInternalFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaPipelineServerInternal, inheriting from IMediaPipelineFactory.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineServerInternal
classes.description: Interface for internal server media pipeline operations, including data availability notification.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IMediaPipelineServerInternalFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineServerInternal
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a new IMediaPipelineServerInternal instance, given client, video requirements, session ID, shared memory buffer, and decryption service.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Indicates that media data is available, with status, number of frames, and request ID.
